pages.title: Calabi-Yau Manifold
pages.text: A compact six-dimensional shape of the kind string theory curls its extra dimensions into, its holes and twists deciding which particles exist. This one is folded small enough to hold. It looks different from every angle, and touching one surface makes my finger reappear on another.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Topological Phase Transmuter I folded a Topological Insulator around a Void Lattice Shard, with a condensate to keep it coherent. The result had six compact dimensions I could count. Bulk monoliths and Calabi-Yau knots hide them too.
